description: Source code for a wizard interface in OpenERP/Odoo for modifying report templates (.SXW files) using Tiny OpenOffice plugin. Implements a multi-step form for report selection, modification, and upload.

classes.name: base_report_designer_modify
classes.description: Wizard class for report modification workflow, including report upload, retrieval, and update.

methods.name: _upload_report_clear
methods.description: Clears the uploaded report file data.

methods.name: _upload_report
methods.description: Processes the uploaded report, converting SXW to RML using tiny_sxw2rml.

methods.name: _get_report
methods.description: Retrieves the current report's SXW content encoded in base64.
